articles.title: Juice Spacecraft Uses Earth's Gravity to Head Toward Jupiter
articles.summary: Juice used Earth's gravity to change direction and gain speed on its way to Jupiter. The flyby also helped its team test science instruments.

articles.title: A Quieter Boat Propeller Could Help Whales Hear Each Other
articles.summary: Sharrow Marine and Ocean Alliance are testing looped boat propellers near whales to explore a design that may reduce underwater noise.

articles.title: A Queen Mole-Rat's Scent Helps Keep Her Colony Calm
articles.summary: Experiments found that a queen naked mole-rat's scent helps prevent fighting and affects reproduction in her colony.
